name: Sam Mountain
kicker: Sacred hill of temples in Vĩnh Tế
summary: Give a morning to Núi Sam in phường Vĩnh Tế, the hill Vietnam Tourism covers with about 200 religious sites. The walk at the foot takes in Bà Chúa Xứ, Tây An, the cave pagoda, and the Thoại Ngọc Hầu tomb. The climb, and any cable car, is a separate effort. Skip the hill on the heaviest festival days if you wanted quiet halls.
timeNeeded: A morning, longer if you climb
getThere: Road from the river wards. One article prints both about 5 km and about 7 km.
heroCaption: Núi Sam from the road, the hill behind the trees

notice.title: The foot of the hill is not the climb
notice.body: The shrine, Tây An, the cave pagoda, and the tomb are one walk. The path up the hill, and any cable car, is another. No cable-car fee was published. Check on arrival.

body: Núi Sam is the national tourism hill above Châu Đốc, in phường Vĩnh Tế. The 2026 festival of Bà Chúa Xứ opened here, not in the town ward. Vietnam Tourism describes a sacred hill with about 200 large and small religious sites on the slopes. The useful morning is the cluster at the foot: Miếu Bà Chúa Xứ, Lăng Thoại Ngọc Hầu, Chùa Tây An, and Chùa Hang, which TITC also calls Phước Điền.

Walk those halls first. Climb, or ride a cable car if one is running, when you want the plain and the sugar palms from above. TITC names that combination and does not print a fare. From the first lunar month through the Via festival, the same pages describe crowds from early morning until late. Come outside that window if the buildings are the point.

One older national-tourism article prints the hill as both about 5 km and about 7 km from the city, on the road up from Long Xuyen. Minutes were not printed. Check on arrival. Do not budget the whole mountain as one ticketed cave.

gettingThere: The hill is in phường Vĩnh Tế, tỉnh An Giang, a short road from the river wards of Châu Đốc. It is not inside the town ward formed from Vĩnh Nguơn, Châu Phú A, Châu Phú B, Vĩnh Mỹ, and part of Vĩnh Châu. An older festival page prints both about 5 km and about 7 km in the same article, and a road from Long Xuyen on provincial road 10. No 2026 minute count was printed.
